title: Dadista · los dados
description: Dadista's sheet (docs/animas/dadaista/), the university friends' ánima, as built at level 3: the party with it worn, the look up close, its dice, the skill list, each face as a clip (a hand, scissors, an eye, brackets, a red blank, the Comodín), what the eye and the scissors leave on a foe, Defender dealing new dice, the Racha counter on the plate, Agitar and Estrella fugaz as clips, and its row on the status screen's Ánimas page. Its maná is dice, each face a move; every die spent adds to the Racha. Gerard wears it in the fight tester beside Aitor's Matemágico, against two sturdy dogs. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }));
ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['mano', 'ojo', 'corchete']; g.secondary = 3; delete g.lastFace; });

steps.caption: Dadista worn: its maná is dice, and each face is a move. Three dice beside Gerard (a hand, an eye, brackets), the same faces on his plate, and the ánima's interface (ivory paper on ink)

steps.eval: { const at = window.gerard.game.fighterAt('gerard'); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: at.x, y: at.y + .9, z: at.z }, 1.25); }

steps.caption: The look: black jacket, cream shirt, a red bow tie and a brass monocle on its cord

steps.eval: { const at = window.gerard.game.fighterAt('gerard'); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: at.x + .5, y: at.y + .8, z: at.z }, 1.6); }

steps.caption: The dice: ivory cubes printed with their ornaments, floating in a column beside whoever wears it
The skill list at level 3: Tirar dado (what it does is the face of the die it spends), Agitar (once a fight) and Estrella fugaz
Tirar dado: the sheet turns into the hand, each die with its face and what it does. The die under the cursor comes forward beside Gerard
The eye, then whom: the first dog
Ojo: the die flies tumbling, lands and leaves Punto débil, the next blow on that dog does triple
What the eye leaves on the foe: Punto débil, under its plate

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['mano', 'corchete', 'blanco']; g.secondary = 3; });

steps.caption: The blank repeats the last face spent: now it would be another eye
Mano on the dog the eye marked: Punto débil spent, the triple

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['corchete', 'blanco']; g.secondary = 2; });

steps.caption: Corchete aims at the party: whom to protect
Corchete: the die lands on the ally, protected until the round ends

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['tijeras', 'blanco']; g.secondary = 2; });

steps.caption: Tijeras: two cuts cross on the dog, the scissors snap shut in red where they meet, cut paper falls, and it bleeds
En blanco repeating Tijeras: its red empty frame is stamped first, then the cut is drawn inside it
What the scissors leave: Sangrado on the dog, the same wound as Papagato's

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['comodin', 'mano']; g.secondary = 2; });

steps.caption: The Comodín: now and then a die dealt is the black one with the red star, beside Gerard and on his plate
In the hand it goes first: «Comodín · Golpe fuerte a todos»
The Comodín: its red star stamped on each dog, one after the other, and a hand lands on each

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['tijeras']; g.secondary = 1; });

steps.caption: Defender: two points of maná back, two new dice dropping into the hand with their faces

steps.eval: ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 400; }); const g = s.allies.find(a => a.id === 'gerard'); g.dice = ['blanco', 'corchete']; g.secondary = 2; g.racha = 3; delete g.lastFace; });

steps.caption: Racha: the dice spent since Dadista was put on, a star with its count on Gerard's plate; each one is Crítico +10 % (▲ CRÍ under his bars)
A poor hand (a blank with nothing to repeat, brackets) and Racha 3: Agitar is there, «1 vez»
Agitar: the whole hand thrown again without spending the turn; with Racha 3 or more one die comes out the Comodín
The turn is still Gerard's, the list still open: Agitar now reads «Usado»
Estrella fugaz is paid with a die of any face: the hand, to pick the one given up (the cursor starts on the one worth least)
Estrella fugaz: the die flies shedding bluish-white stars and breaks into them on the dog (magic of no element); with Racha 3 it spends it and two new dice drop into the hand
After it: «Racha −3, +2 dados». The counter is back at 1 and the hand is full again
The Ánimas page: Dadista in Gerard's extra slot, at level 3, and what it knows
